llm.summary: This is a transparent Chinese-language Figma-to-code guidance skill with no bundled executable code, persistence, or hidden data handling.

dimensions.detail: Use of Figma MCP to read a user-selected frame is proportionate to the code-generation purpose, and the package does not request broad local indexing, credential harvesting, or unrelated network access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown/text guidance and references only; no install script, executable file, dependency installation, or runtime hook was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are entirely in Chinese and guide code generation, component mapping, design-token use, and accessibility; they do not contain prompt overrides, deception, or unrelated agent-control instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistent memory writes, background workers, scheduled tasks, privilege escalation, tool wrapping, or system-level changes were present in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to help agents turn selected Figma frames into React/front-end code that follows an existing component library and design tokens; the referenced Figma MCP access is purpose-aligned and user-directed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you are comfortable with Chinese-language instructions and want an agent to use your selected Figma context for code generation. Keep Figma MCP access limited to the intended design file or frame and review generated code before merging it.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: SKILL.md is Chinese-only, but this is visible user-facing documentation for a Figma code-generation workflow and does not create hidden authority or unsafe behavior.
[SQP-3] expected: examples/sample-prompts.txt contains Chinese sample prompts for expected Figma-to-code scenarios; this is a usability/localization limitation rather than a security concern.
[SQP-3] expected: references/component-library.txt is a Chinese component-library reference with ordinary UI component props and mappings; no risky runtime instructions were found.
[SQP-3] expected: references/design-tokens.txt is a Chinese design-token reference containing colors, spacing, radius, and typography guidance; no privilege, persistence, or data-flow concern was found.
